svg.title: Cho Oyu — mountain relief
svg.desc: Northern face from Tibet. Broad summit plateau, banded ice cliffs, glacial terraces and northwest shoulder. Layered vector contour adaptation of a photograph by Mark Horrell. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cho_Oyu.jpg. License: CC BY-SA 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Changes: sky removed, cropped, tonal contours traced, blue and white palette.
